commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd projects/kobra2-neo; uv sync --frozen >/dev/null; uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import kobra_plot as kp

src = Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150.svg"
out = Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-EXACT.gcode"
preview = Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-EXACT-preview.svg"
reportp = Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-EXACT-report.json"
profile = kp.load_profile()
page_w = page_h = 150.0

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="kobra-map-exact-") as td:
    norm = Path(td)/"normalized.svg"
    kp.normalize_svg(src, norm)
    lines = kp.load_normalized_svg(norm)
    root = ET.parse(norm).getroot()
    vb = root.attrib.get("viewBox")
    if not vb:
        raise RuntimeError("normalized SVG missing viewBox")
    vals = [float(x) for x in vb.replace(',', ' ').split()]
    if len(vals) != 4 or vals[2] <= 0 or vals[3] <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"bad viewBox: {vb}")
    vx, vy, vw, vh = vals
    ws = profile.workspace
    target_cx = (ws.draw_min_x + ws.draw_max_x)/2.0
    target_cy = (ws.draw_min_y + ws.draw_max_y)/2.0
    off_x = target_cx - page_w/2.0
    off_y = target_cy - page_h/2.0
    mapped=[]
    for line in lines:
        o=[]
        for x,y in line:
            px=(x-vx)/vw*page_w
            py=(y-vy)/vh*page_h
            if profile.orientation.swap_xy:
                px,py=py,px
            if profile.orientation.flip_x:
                px=page_w-px
            if profile.orientation.flip_y:
                py=page_h-py
            o.append((off_x+px, off_y+py))
        mapped.append(o)
    b=kp.bounds(mapped)
    eps=1e-7
    if not (ws.draw_min_x-eps <= b.min_x <= b.max_x <= ws.draw_max_x+eps and ws.draw_min_y-eps <= b.min_y <= b.max_y <= ws.draw_max_y+eps):
        raise RuntimeError(f"mapped bounds outside canonical envelope: {b}")
    g=kp.generate_gcode(mapped, profile)
    safety=kp.validate_gcode(g, profile)
    if not safety.get("valid"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"validator failed: {safety}")
    out.write_text(g, encoding="utf-8")
    preview.write_text(kp.render_preview(mapped, profile), encoding="utf-8")
    stats=kp.geometry_stats(mapped, profile)
    stats["output_bounds"]=b.as_dict()
    report={
      "mode":"preserve-150mm-svg-page",
      "source":str(src),
      "source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
      "page_mm":{"width":page_w,"height":page_h,"offset_x":off_x,"offset_y":off_y},
      "normalized_viewBox":{"min_x":vx,"min_y":vy,"width":vw,"height":vh},
      "geometry":stats,
      "safety":safety,
      "profile":{"pen_up_z":profile.tool.pen_up_z,"pen_down_z":profile.tool.pen_down_z,"travel_feed":profile.motion.travel_feed,"draw_feed":profile.motion.draw_feed,"z_feed":profile.motion.z_feed,"draw_envelope":[ws.draw_min_x,ws.draw_max_x,ws.draw_min_y,ws.draw_max_y]},
      "gcode_sha256":hashlib.sha256(g.encode()).hexdigest(),
    }
    reportp.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print("VIEWBOX", vb)
    print("PAGE_OFFSET", off_x, off_y)
    print("CONTENT_BOUNDS", b.as_dict())
    print("STATS", json.dumps(stats,sort_keys=True))
    print("SAFETY", json.dumps(safety,sort_keys=True))
    print("SHA256", report["gcode_sha256"])
    print("FILES", out, preview, reportp)
PY
OUT="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-EXACT.gcode"; test -s "$OUT"; echo '=== SANITY ==='; head -8 "$OUT"; echo '...'; tail -8 "$OUT"; if grep -En '(^|[[:space:]])(G28|G91|M10[49]|M140|M190|M82|M83)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])E[-+0-9.]' "$OUT"; then echo BAD_COMMAND; exit 22; else echo NO_DISALLOWED_COMMANDS; fi; echo EXACT150_DONE
